stories.headline: FIFA confirms US-led 2031 and UK 2035 Women's World Cup hosts
stories.dek: Both bids were unopposed; the 2031 event will be the first women's World Cup with 48 teams, and Scottish football figures say the 2035 award will inspire young players.
stories.summary: FIFA confirmed on Monday that the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica will host the 2031 Women's World Cup, and England, Scotland, Northern Ireland and Wales the 2035 edition. Both bids were uncontested.
body: FIFA confirmed on Monday that the United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica will host the 2031 Women's World Cup, and that England, Scotland, Northern Ireland and Wales will stage the 2035 tournament.

Both bids were unchallenged. DW reported that FIFA president Gianni Infantino had said last year that neither faced a rival. The 2031 event will be the first women's World Cup with 48 teams, matching the men's format. The 2011 tournament in Germany had 16.

The US has hosted the women's event twice, in 1999 and 2003, and has won it four times. Emily Cosler, US Soccer's vice-president of strategy, told The Guardian: "We expect and plan for the 2031 Women's World Cup to be the largest women's sporting event in history."

The 2035 tournament will be the first World Cup in the UK since 1966. The Guardian described it as set to be the largest single-sport event staged in the country. British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said it would bring "visitors, investment and jobs to every part of the country."
Scotland captain Caroline Weir told the BBC the award would bring "an amazing decade of excitement". She said a young girl now could aim to play for Scotland at Hampden Park in a World Cup.

Angie Hind, Scotland Under-23 head coach and the Scottish FA's player pathway manager, said the players in the current pathway, from age 13 to the Under-23s, would be those wearing the Scotland shirt at the tournament. She said it fits with Project 2035, announced this month by the SFA and the Scottish government to boost the girls' and women's game.

Shirley Martin, the SFA's head of women's and girls football, said the association hopes to "double our participation over that time". She also said: "The one thing we need to do is increase the crowds that come to matches."

The Guardian reported that 15 of the 22 stadiums in the UK bid hold more than 33,000 people and 12 exceed 50,000. The list will be cut to about 16. At Euro 2022 in England, only two of 10 venues held more than 33,000.
The next Women's World Cup is in Brazil, from June 24 to July 25 next year. Eighteen of the 32 teams have qualified, including Germany.
keyFacts: 2031 hosts: United States, Mexico, Costa Rica and Jamaica; 48 teams for the first time.
2035 hosts: England, Scotland, Northern Ireland and Wales; first UK World Cup since 1966.
Both bids were uncontested.
The 2035 bid lists 22 stadiums, to be trimmed to about 16.
Next tournament: Brazil, June 24 to July 25 next year.
stories.background: The 2023 Women's World Cup final was won by Spain, who beat England. The UK also hosts the men's Euro 2028 in England, Scotland and Wales, along with the Republic of Ireland. In 2022, England hosted the Women's Euros, where organisers were seen to have underestimated demand and used several small stadiums.
stories.whyItMatters: The awards set host plans for the next decade. Scottish officials say they will aim to double participation and raise match attendances.

stories.headline: Alcaraz beats Zverev in Turin to win ATP Finals title
stories.dek: The Spaniard's win completes a set of all four Grand Slams and the season-ending championship, a list that includes Federer, Agassi and Djokovic, according to Sportstar.
stories.summary: Carlos Alcaraz beat Alexander Zverev 6-2, 9-7 (7) in the ATP Finals title match in Turin on Sunday. He becomes the first Spanish champion at the event since Alex Corretja in 1998.
body: Carlos Alcaraz won the ATP Finals on Sunday, November 23, beating Alexander Zverev 6-2, 9-7 (7) in the title match in Turin.

Zverev had reached the final without dropping a service game. He was under pressure at once, saving three break points in the opening game. Alcaraz broke two games later and moved quickly through the first set.

The second set was closer, with both players exchanging breaks. Alcaraz led 3-0 in the tiebreak before Zverev won six points in a row. Alcaraz then saved three set points in succession, set up a mini-break and finished the match on his second match point with a drop-shot.

The result puts Alcaraz among the men's singles players who have won all four Grand Slams and the ATP Finals, a group that also includes Roger Federer, Andre Agassi and Novak Djokovic, Sportstar reported. He is the first Spanish player to win the event since Corretja in 1998.
The season had been uneven for Alcaraz, who spent several months out with injury. He also had a hamstring problem earlier in the tournament, according to the report.
"It's been an amazing week. I couldn't finish the week in a better way, so I'm really proud," Alcaraz said after the match.

"I've been through really difficult moments with myself, with my team, and we could go through everything. I'm playing great tennis, so for me, lifting this trophy is something that I've been chasing for a really long time. It means the world to me," he said.

stories.headline: Division Palermo beats Vir Das's Fool Volume for International Emmy comedy award
stories.dek: Vijay Sethupathi, the only Indian among the presenters, handed out an award at the New York ceremony, where Real Kashmir Football Club was also nominated.
stories.summary: Argentina's Division Palermo won the International Emmy for comedy on Monday, ahead of Vir Das's Netflix special Fool Volume. Vijay Sethupathi presented an award at the 54th ceremony in New York.
body: Argentina's Division Palermo won the International Emmy Award for comedy series at the 54th ceremony in New York on Monday, November 23, beating Vir Das's Netflix special Vir Das: Fool Volume.

NDTV reported that the winner was Season 2 of the Netflix original, produced by K & S Films. The other nominees in the category were the UK's Man vs Baby and Spain's Old Dog, New Tricks. The Indian Express named the winner as "Community Squad"; NDTV's account used the title Division Palermo.
It was Das's third nomination in the category. He was nominated in 2021 for Vir Das: For India and in 2023 for Vir Das: Landing, which won. He hosted the 2024 ceremony.

Before the ceremony, Das said: "There's something wonderfully strange about being nominated for an International Emmy for a show called Fool Volume." He added that the special "came from a period when I literally lost my voice".

Vijay Sethupathi was among the presenters at the event, held at the New York Hilton Midtown, and appeared on the red carpet in a black suit with gold embroidery. Hindustan Times described him as the lone Indian at the awards this year. The Indian Express and Filmfare also listed him as a presenter.

Hindustan Times said producer Kavita Gupta, a board member of the International Academy of Television Arts and Sciences, helped bring him to the event. She also helped Das host in 2024. Actor Michael Urie hosted this year's ceremony.

India's other nomination was Real Kashmir Football Club, a SonyLIV series starring Manav Kaul and Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub, in the drama category. Its rivals were A Thousand Blows (UK), Careme (France) and Menem (Argentina). The sources did not report the drama winner.
Sethupathi's next film, Train, directed by Mysskin, is scheduled for release in theatres on December 4, 2026.

stories.headline: Ramayana: Part 1 passes ₹1,704 crore worldwide, becomes Ranbir Kapoor's biggest hit
stories.dek: Daily India earnings fell 64.33 per cent on Monday, and the film is set to lose more than 700 North American theatres this Friday.
stories.summary: Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana: Part 1 reached ₹1,704.65 crore worldwide on day 19, according to Sacnilk, and is now Ranbir Kapoor's highest-grossing film in India. Its India net was ₹12.70 crore on Monday, down sharply from Sunday.
body: Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana: Part 1 has reached ₹1,704.65 crore in worldwide collection after 19 days in theatres, and has overtaken Animal as Ranbir Kapoor's highest-grossing film in India, NDTV reported, citing tracker Sacnilk.

On Monday, November 23, the film earned ₹12.70 crore net in India across 15,696 shows, Sacnilk said. That was 64.33 per cent below Sunday's ₹35.60 crore. India net collection now stands at ₹955.45 crore and India gross at ₹1,141.65 crore.

The Hindi version contributed ₹9.25 crore from 13,442 shows. Malayalam added ₹1.50 crore, Kannada ₹85 lakh, Tamil ₹80 lakh and Telugu ₹30 lakh. Hindi occupancy was 19.02 per cent for 3D shows and 14.42 per cent for 2D shows.

NDTV put the film's India net ahead of Animal's ₹553.87 crore. It also reported that the film had passed ₹700 crore net in Hindi, the second fastest to do so after Dhurandhar 2, which took 10 days. NDTV said the film's worldwide total is about ₹70 crore ahead of Dhurandhar 2. The Indian Express, however, listed Dhurandhar 2 at ₹1,813.39 crore worldwide, and said it was unclear whether Ramayana would pass that figure.
The Indian Express said overseas earnings stand at ₹563 crore; NDTV gave ₹567 crore. Both outlets drew on Sacnilk figures.

In North America, the film opened in more than 1,400 theatres, according to Collider as cited by NDTV. It lost over 300 in its second week and is expected to drop to 681 this Friday, a loss of more than 700 from opening week.

Trade analyst Taran Adarsh said the third weekend showed "ample stamina", with growth of 78.04 per cent on Saturday and 25.31 per cent on Sunday. He noted a discounted ticket offer on Tuesday, which is a holiday for Guru Nanak Jayanti. Two new releases, Yeh Prem Mol Liya and Gunmaster G9, arrive on Friday.

Hindustan Times said ₹45 crore separates the film from ₹1,000 crore net in India. The film released on November 5. Producer Namit Malhotra has said Part 2 will arrive during Diwali 2028, giving the team an extra year to complete it.

stories.headline: Avengers: Doomsday final trailer shows Steve Rogers' return and X-Men arrival
stories.dek: Marvel's last trailer before release shows Chris Evans' Rogers living in retirement with a son until the Fantastic Four turn up, while Robert Downey Jr's Doom stays largely hidden.
stories.summary: Marvel Studios released the final trailer for Avengers: Doomsday on Monday, showing Steve Rogers with a teenage son, the X-Men assembling under Cyclops, and Robert Downey Jr's Doctor Doom. The film opens in India on December 17.
body: Marvel Studios released the final trailer for Avengers: Doomsday on Monday, November 23, showing Chris Evans' Steve Rogers in retirement with Peggy Carter and a teenage son, and the X-Men joining the Avengers and Fantastic Four against Doctor Doom.

The trailer opens with Rogers speaking to Carter, played by Hayley Atwell, about the life they chose after he returned the Infinity Stones. "We made a choice, that we knew was right," he tells her, according to Hindustan Times. CNA reported that the son is played by Wesley Holloway.

When the boy asks, "Dad, were you a superhero?", Rogers answers, "There were six of us, called the Avengers". The quiet is broken when the Fantastic Four, played by Pedro Pascal, Vanessa Kirby, Joseph Quinn and Ebon Moss-Bachrach, arrive at the family's home to seek his help against an emerging threat.

CNA said the boy's name has not been officially revealed. Some fans have speculated he could be called James, after Bucky Barnes, but neither the name nor the character's significance has been confirmed.

The X-Men appear as well. James Marsden's Cyclops calls out, "To me, my X-Men!" Hindustan Times listed Alan Cumming as Nightcrawler, Channing Tatum as Gambit, Rebecca Romijn as Mystique and Kelsey Grammer as Beast, and said Patrick Stewart returns as Professor X and Ian McKellen as Magneto.

Downey Jr appears as Victor Von Doom, who warns the heroes: "All of you have lived stolen lives. But now you must give them back". CNA reported that his face remains concealed. Thor, played by Chris Hemsworth, is shown facing Doom and later addressing a room of heroes. "I don't even know who half of you are," he says, before asking them to "put aside your petty squabbles".

Space.com said the Latverian witches, the subject of online theories for months, are seen in motion for the first time. It added that Marvel Studios head Kevin Feige has dismissed the theory that this Doom is a variant of Tony Stark, the character Downey Jr played earlier.

Joe and Anthony Russo direct the film. Hindustan Times said it opens worldwide on December 18 and a day earlier in India, the same day as Dune: Part Three in the US and other markets. CNA gave December 17 as the Singapore date.
keyFacts: The final trailer was released on Monday, November 23.
Chris Evans' Steve Rogers is shown with Peggy Carter and a teenage son.
James Marsden's Cyclops calls out "To me, my X-Men!"
Doctor Doom's face stays concealed, CNA reported.
The film opens in India on December 17, a day before the worldwide release.
stories.background: In Avengers: Endgame, Rogers travelled back in time to return the Infinity Stones and Mjolnir, then stayed in the past to grow old with Carter. He later passed his shield to Sam Wilson, played by Anthony Mackie. Downey Jr's Tony Stark died in that film.
stories.whyItMatters: The film is Marvel Studios' first Avengers release since 2019, and it opens on the same day as Dune: Part Three.

stories.headline: Dhanush-Mammootty film OM claims ₹101 crore as Monday collections fall 61%
stories.dek: Trade tracker Sacnilk puts the spy thriller's worldwide gross at ₹93.40 crore after four days, below the ₹101 crore the makers announced for the first three.
stories.summary: The makers of OM: Operation Mole say the spy thriller grossed ₹101.7 crore worldwide in three days. Sacnilk reports a 61% drop on Monday to ₹6.20 crore net in India and a lower worldwide figure.
body: RTake Studios, co-producer of the Dhanush-Mammootty spy thriller OM: Operation Mole, said the film grossed ₹101.7 crore worldwide in its first three days, a figure that trade tracker Sacnilk's numbers do not match.

Sacnilk reported that the film earned ₹6.20 crore net in India on Monday, a 61% fall from Sunday's ₹15.90 crore. That took its domestic net total to ₹55.95 crore, or ₹64.90 crore gross, according to NDTV's reading of the tracker's data.

Overseas, the film added ₹1.50 crore on Monday, bringing its overseas gross to ₹28.50 crore. Sacnilk's worldwide gross stands at ₹93.40 crore, NDTV reported. Hindustan Times said the tracker had put the first-weekend worldwide gross at ₹85 crore, against the makers' claim of ₹101 crore.

The film, directed by Rajkumar Periasamy, opened on Friday, November 20, with ₹18.10 crore net in India, the biggest opening of Dhanush's career, Hindustan Times reported. Saturday brought ₹16.25 crore and Sunday ₹15.90 crore, so the weekend dipped rather than rose.

Monday occupancy was 21.9% across 6,114 shows, according to Sacnilk. Tamil was the strongest market, earning ₹4.10 crore from 3,359 shows. On Sunday, the Tamil version made ₹11.55 crore, Telugu ₹3.8 crore and Hindi ₹55 lakh. Hindustan Times said Hindi collections have stayed low.

Reviews were mixed. In her NDTV review, Latha Srinivasan wrote: "Dhanush and Mammootty are the biggest strengths of the film inevitably and this is what makes the narrative compelling." Hindustan Times said Sai Pallavi drew praise as a special task force cop, while the music, direction and writing drew online criticism.

The Indian Express noted that the figure would make OM Mammootty's first officially ₹100 crore film, though he is not its lead. His Patriot earned ₹79.98 crore earlier this year. Dhanush's Kara earned ₹53.78 crore, and Tere Ishk Mein (2025) collected ₹161.96 crore worldwide.
OM also stars Sreeleela, Naseeruddin Shah and Indrans, with music by Sai Abhyankkar. Hindustan Times said the film faced little competition other than Dulquer Salmaan's Aakasamlo Oka Tara in Telugu.
keyFacts: Makers RTake Studios announced a ₹101.7 crore worldwide gross for the first three days.
Sacnilk: ₹6.20 crore net in India on Monday, down 61%.
Sacnilk's India net total after four days is ₹55.95 crore.
Sacnilk's worldwide gross after four days is ₹93.40 crore, per NDTV.
OM opened on Friday, November 20, with ₹18.10 crore net in India.
stories.background: OM: Operation Mole follows an undercover agent who infiltrates a red sanders smuggling network. It is written and directed by Rajkumar Periasamy and produced by Dhanush's Wunderbar Films and RTake Studios. Dhanush said before release that about 30% of the dialogue is in Telugu.
stories.whyItMatters: The gap between the makers' figure and Sacnilk's estimate shows how box-office totals can differ by source, and the weekday numbers will show whether the film holds up after its opening weekend.

stories.headline: Panchayat Season 5 trailer shows new pradhan in Phulera; makers tease film
stories.dek: TVF's Vijay Koshy told the Bhopal launch event that the team has long wanted to take the series to cinema halls, and hopes the full cast will join.
stories.summary: Prime Video released the trailer for Panchayat Season 5 on Monday, with the show returning on December 3. At the launch near Bhopal, TVF president Vijay Koshy said the team hopes one day to make a Panchayat film.
body: Prime Video released the trailer for Panchayat Season 5 on Monday at an event near Bhopal, with the series set to stream from December 3, and a producer used the occasion to say the team wants to make a film.

The 156-second trailer, as described by The Indian Express, opens with former pradhan Brij Bhushan Dubey (Raghubir Yadav), secretary Abhishek Tripathi (Jitendra Kumar), Prahlad Pandey (Faisal Malik) and Vikas Shukla (Chandan Roy) dejected over the change in Phulera. Kranti Devi (Sunita Rajwar) is now pradhan. NDTV noted that the previous season ended with her defeating Manju Devi (Neena Gupta) by 73 votes.

The trailer shows her husband Bhushan, known as Banrakas (Durgesh Kumar), planning moves against Brij Bhushan's camp and giving Abhishek and Vikas menial jobs, according to the Indian Express. It also follows the romance between Abhishek and Brij Bhushan's daughter Rinki (Sanvikaa). The family learns of it, and Brij Bhushan is seen slapping Abhishek. The trailer ends with Abhishek preparing to seek the approval of Brij Bhushan and Manju Devi to marry Rinki.
Prime Video shared the trailer on X with a caption saying: "Kranti Devi's move and Phulera's new state of affairs-everything is about to change."

At the launch, Vijay Koshy, president of The Viral Fever (TVF), which produces the show, spoke about a film version. Hindustan Times and The Indian Express reported him saying the team wanted to take Panchayat to the big screen as far back as 2016. The Indian Express added that few producers were willing to back it then.
"Every storytellers' final destination is the big screen," Koshy said, according to the Indian Express. He said the decision was not influenced by Mirzapur's release in cinemas.

He also said, as quoted by Hindustan Times: "We have hopes, we have dreams of taking it to the big screen. Hopefully, this entire bunch here will also make it part of their dream, and someday we'll see Panchayat, the movie, on the big screen." No timeline or cast was announced.

Both papers noted that Mirzapur: The Film, released this year after three seasons on Prime Video, earned over ₹340 crore worldwide. Manish Menghani of Amazon Prime Video India attended the event along with the cast.
Panchayat Season 5 begins streaming on Prime Video on December 3.

stories.headline: Miley Cyrus marries Maxx Morando in poolside ceremony in Palm Springs
stories.dek: Wayne Coyne of the Flaming Lips officiated the Saturday wedding, attended by family and friends, with the couple sharing photos on her 34th birthday.
stories.summary: Singer Miley Cyrus, 33, married musician Maxx Morando, 28, on Saturday, November 21, in Palm Springs. The couple shared more wedding photos on Monday, which was Cyrus's 34th birthday.
body: Singer Miley Cyrus married her partner of five years, musician Maxx Morando, at a poolside ceremony in Palm Springs on Saturday, November 21, according to Vogue.

Wayne Coyne of the Flaming Lips officiated. Cyrus, 33 at the time of the wedding, and Morando, 28, exchanged vows in front of family and friends under an archway of white flowers and candles. Guests wore black-tie outfits in black.

Cyrus's mother Tish Cyrus and her partner Dominic Purcell attended, as did her father Billy Ray Cyrus and his partner Elizabeth Hurley, and her sister Noah. Vogue reported that the couple held their rehearsal the previous day.

Cyrus wore a long-sleeved silk gown by Saint Laurent, with matching silk slingback pumps and Chopard jewellery. Morando also wore Saint Laurent, a tuxedo with a silk satin tie and sneakers. The photographer was Jose Villa.

Photos obtained by People showed Cyrus smiling and wiping away tears as Morando read his vows. On Monday, her birthday, the couple posted more images covering the day, from preparations to the reception. They included Cyrus being walked down the aisle by her mother and dancing with her father.
For the after-party, Cyrus changed into a black sequined minidress. The couple left in a vintage Mercedes, Vogue reported.

Morando is the drummer for the Los Angeles rock band Liily and works as a songwriter and producer. He played drums for the Regrettes from 2015 to 2018. He worked with Cyrus on the songs "Handstand" and "Violet Chemistry" from her 2023 album Endless Summer Vacation, and contributed to several songs on this year's Bass Persuades, Vogue reported.

Last month the couple sang a duet of Cyrus's "Let's Get Married" at the Hollywood Bowl. Of their work together, Cyrus told Harper's Bazaar: "I've always worked with the people that I love. And Maxx just inspires me so much."
keyFacts: Cyrus and Morando married on Saturday, November 21, in Palm Springs.
Wayne Coyne of the Flaming Lips officiated the ceremony.
Cyrus turned 34 on Monday, when the couple posted more photos.
The pair have been together five years and were engaged in 2025.
Morando is the drummer of the rock band Liily.
stories.background:
Cyrus and Morando met on a blind date in 2021 and made their red-carpet debut as a couple at Gucci's "Love Parade" show in November 2021. Morando proposed during a 2025 trip to Japan, which celebrated her 33rd birthday.

Cyrus said on Good Morning America after the engagement: "I am not easy to surprise." She added that she had "completely surrendered" and was "so, so, so surprised."
